## Paper size and margins in Typst

Every Typst type uses A4 paper and its own margins.
Typst ignores the Quarto options `papersize` and `margin`, and gives no warning.
Letters and invoices use A4 because NF Z 11-001 and DIN 5008 specify it.

## NF Z 11-001 geometry

The NF Z 11-001 dimensions of letters and invoices are not verified against the AFNOR standard.
Do a test print with a window envelope before you send letters.

## German labels

German has the letter labels only.
A German invoice and the other types use the English labels.
Add your own labels with a language file, as [Labels and dates](examples/typst-format.qmd#labels-and-dates) shows.

## Solution identifiers with a hyphen

Quarto stops on a `.solution` with an identifier such as `#worked-answer` ([quarto-dev/quarto-cli#15113](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/15113)).
Use the `sol-` prefix with no other hyphen, or an identifier without a hyphen.

## Footer band of an HTML memo

If all three footer slots are empty, an HTML memo has no footer band.
The PDF memo always has the band.

## veraPDF

Quarto checks the PDF/UA-1 tags only when veraPDF is installed.
Without veraPDF, each render gives a warning.
Run `quarto install verapdf` to install it.
